scope: Published-source authenticity and consistency review, with retained-source exceptions. Check dates do not replace reporting dates.

corrections.change: Port of Vermilion (Abbeville), with officialName Port of Vermilion and search aliases. No recent rebranding or formal former-name claim.
All32 summaries now have explicit supporting citations; added4 official port pages and linked existing project documents where needed. Narrowed Lake Charles, Vermilion and Columbia wording.
Replaced2024 current extract with2025 final EIA release; all60 cells reconciled, including6 missing cells. Kept2024 as a clearly named archive.

Pinned all32 requests to start=2001/end=2020 after discovering API default-period drift. Adopted832 explicitly scoped values;265 solar cells differ by0.0001-0.0002 kWh/m²/day. Wind values and resource ranks unchanged.
Repaired NASA methodology URL; surfaced restricted/unavailable historical source status and kept HTTP checks distinct from claim verification.
Guarded missing values and units; aged NWS and MISO timestamps on an in-page clock, preserved unknowns, and clarified forecast precipitation and external AIS limits.

limitations: This is reconciliation to published sources, not independent certification or field verification. A matching source may be erroneous or stale.
Historical facility fields remain the self-reported, unaudited May-June 2023 survey published in the 2024 LLA report. Cargo comparisons remain CY2023; boundary source years remain 2019-2021.

Three primary coordinate documents (Tensas, Vidalia and the Vinton LED PDF) restricted fresh downloads with HTTP403. Previously retained evidence remains explicitly historical or proposed where applicable.

Cameron and Ouachita Census address-interpolation results changed by less than/about a meter on fresh query. The dated September approximate snapshots are retained; neither is a surveyed terminal entrance.

ECO historical claims rely on a retained authentic PDF; its original URL returned404. Digital Lumens historical vendor comparison relies on the indexed primary case study; its original URL was unavailable (410/403). No independent savings measurement was obtained.
A site utility listing, an alternative provider list or a proposed connection does not identify every terminal meter or prove exclusive port-wide service.
Annual port electricity use, peak demand, renewable share and backup capacity remain unknown; no substitute values were generated.
NASA is a gridded 2001-2020 resource climatology. Rankings are within this 32-point dataset, not solar/wind feasibility scores.
EIA reliability describes utility-state reporting populations in2025, not individual port outages; IEEE and other-method values require care in comparison.

Weather and MISO are requested external feeds with source timestamps and manual refresh; retrieval success does not establish continuous live availability. No serving/nearest electricity node assignment was verified.
The optional AIS iframe is third-party content. Successful vessel rendering remains unverified; no verified arrivals, departures or counts are calculated.
Authored application/data/configuration/documentation were reviewed. Third-party dependency source code was not line-by-line audited. No public GitHub deployment was verified.
